_note: W1a renderer parity views for tools/parity_capture.gd (Mobile vs Compatibility). Tool data only: nothing in the game reads it. pos = [x, z] in map metres; the camera stands eye_m above the terrain under it. yaw_deg is a compass bearing (0 = north = -z, 90 = east = +x, as the map data), pitch_deg is up-positive, fov_deg is the vertical FOV (the game's 16:9 row of data/camera.json is 75). soldier (optional): the match's local player pawn is moved to at [x, z] on the terrain, facing the camera and turned turn_deg; in every other view it is hidden.

views.name: citadel_top
views.reason: Perf point citadel_top (tests/test_m2w1_world_kit.gd; there (0, 5), moved 19 m north so the Arx_Eagle pole at the origin does not fill the frame) on alesia_500: the Arx top looking north at Porta Arcis, sun in frame (glow, sky, sun disc), the Arx gate braziers just outside it.

views.name: porta_aquilae
views.reason: Perf point porta_aquilae (outer wall r 222, bearing 0) seen from 26 m inside: the four-brazier cluster at the gate (per-object light limit), the flags, and the north backdrop through the gate.

views.name: field_corner
views.reason: Perf point field_corner (MapChunks.standard_points corner, -250, -250) looking out west-south-west: skirt, the three hill rings out to about 2240 m, the far spire and a far beacon (far-plane clipping, fog, sky horizon), zone wall if in frame.

views.name: centre_standard
views.reason: Perf point centre_standard (the play centre; the standard point's fixed y 1.7 is inside the Arx hill and the origin inside the Arx_Eagle collider, so 8 m south on the terrain) looking south-south-east away from the sun: Arx, town, Porta Vulcani's two braziers, the south backdrop.
